name: Ticket Tagger
description: Tags support tickets with every topic that applies: refund, login, mobile, shipping. Runs on 0G Compute's TeeML model (0gm-1.0-35b-a3b).

task.instructions: Tag each support ticket with every tag that applies, and only those: refund (the customer asks for money back), login (cannot sign in), mobile (mentions the phone app, Android or iPhone), shipping (about delivery or a package). Use an empty list when none apply.

labels.name: login
labels.hint: log in, login, sign in, password

labels.name: mobile
labels.hint: android, iphone, phone app, mobile app
